author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: An original, gently stylized armored fish for an imaginative prehistoric world. Static artistic interpretation inspired by Bothriolepis canadensis; colors and simplified details are artistic.
description.zh: 为奇想史前世界创作的温和风格装甲鱼。以沟鳞鱼为灵感的静态艺术化演绎，色彩及简化细节为艺术选择。

sources.consulted: Figures 2–3 and 5–7; visual pixels inspected for the whole body, high posterior crest and retracted pectoral articulation; original study, 2014.

reconstruction_notes: Original modeled geometry; no downloaded mesh, scan, reference artwork or texture incorporated.
Artistic muted sage palette; simplified plate divisions, mouth, tiny spines and surface ornament.
Long posterior body, high vaulted armor, one dorsal fin, paired two-part retracted pectorals; no pelvic or anal fins.
Gentle tail pose is a static composition, not a validated swimming gait.
Soft body and armor overlap internally at their anatomical attachment; small fitted seam strips are intentional.
